name: Relevance
description: Measures how relevant and contextually appropriate the response is to the previous message.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response encourages further interaction and maintains the flow of the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the response within the conversation.

name: Information Quality
description: Measures the accuracy, depth, and relevance of the information provided in the response.

name: Empathy
description: Evaluates the degree to which the response shows understanding and consideration of the other person's feelings and perspectives.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and creativity in the response, including the use of interesting facts or unique insights.

name: Clarity
description: Evaluates the clarity and understandability of the response, including the use of clear and concise language.
